  "api_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/brave/brave-browser/issues/12723",
  "title": "Implement onboarding for P3A on Android",
  "body": "## Description\r\n\r\nThe follow up issue for https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/6176 . It is required to implement notification about P3A during onboarding as it is done for desktop.\r\n\r\n## Designs\r\n\r\nFor new users, show an initial welcome screen with P3A checkbox before the privacy onboarding experience:\r\n\r\n\r\n![loadingP3A](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2388823/99302230-f2e46780-2803-11eb-951a-c7a12f147a99.gif)\r\n\r\n(This has the same Brave logo animation as in the first version of onboarding.)\r\n\r\n![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2388823/99301360-b401e200-2802-11eb-9c7d-4341fa52048d.png)\r\n\r\nFor new users who viewed the onboarding message `p3a.enabled` should be `true`, `p3a.notice_acknowledged` should be `true`\r\n\r\nFor existing users, show the P3A checkbox modal on next app launch: \r\n\r\n![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/2388823/103948440-a116da00-50ee-11eb-967c-5d5d7e547353.png)\r\n\r\nThe P3A checkbox modal takes priority over any other modals that might be in queue (for example, set Brave as default browser).\r\n\r\n\"Private product analytics\" links to `https://brave.com/p3a`\r\n\r\n## Assets\r\nFigma: https://www.figma.com/file/atoL4LN2kd8ILnPGwohUoV/?node-id=1511%3A24317\r\n",
  "author": "Participant 1",
  "created_at": "2020-11-16T19:12:55Z",
  "updated_at": "2021-02-15T03:28:49Z",
  "state": "closed",
  "closed_at": null,
  "issue_fetched_at": "2026-11-05T06:23:34.351484+00:00",

  ],

      "body": "Designs added!"
    },
    {
      "id": 728296125,
      "url": "https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/12723#issuecomment-728296125",
      "created_at": "2020-11-16T20:08:32Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "awesome, thanks @karenkliu "
    },
    {
      "id": 755626375,
      "url": "https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/12723#issuecomment-755626375",
      "created_at": "2021-01-06T20:15:17Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "@karenkliu is the checkbox is clickable here ? if it is, then what should happen when user unselect the check box ? "
    },
    {
      "id": 755630759,
      "url": "https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/12723#issuecomment-755630759",
      "created_at": "2021-01-06T20:18:34Z",
      "updated_at": "2021-01-06T20:19:31Z",
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "@deeppandya The user can tap on the checkbox to unselect it. If unselected, `p3a.enabled` should be `false`, `p3a.notice_acknowledged` should be `true`\r\n\r\nCheckbox spec is here: https://www.figma.com/file/z9wmg2FCwuXx9FLbDo5avJ/Platform-UI-Brave-desktop?node-id=105%3A244 (use Roboto for the text but try to match checkbox color and style)"
    },
    {
      "id": 757648054,
      "url": "https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/12723#issuecomment-757648054",
      "created_at": "2021-01-11T06:19:00Z",
      "updated_at": "2021-01-11T06:19:16Z",
      "author": "Participant 4",
      "body": "@deeppandya can we close https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/6688 as a duplicate? This has more details\r\n\r\nBasically, we need to cover the new user (onboarding) case - but also the case where user is already an existing user. If you want, you can edit/use https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/6688 to cover the existing user case"
    },
    {
      "id": 757648650,
      "url": "https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/12723#issuecomment-757648650",
      "created_at": "2021-01-11T06:20:40Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "@bsclifton I think this issue has covered both scenarios. I will close the other issue "
    },
    {
      "id": 775666329,
      "url": "https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/12723#issuecomment-775666329",
      "created_at": "2021-02-09T05:06:14Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 5",
      "body": "Verification passed on OnePlus 6T with Android 10 running 1.20.100 x64 build\r\n- Verified P3A onboarding is shown on a clean install\r\n- Verified opt-in or opt-out on a clean install shows privacy stats onboarding immediately after P3A is dismissed\r\n- Verified onboarding is shown on an upgrade profile\r\n- Verified P3A metrics are captured based and sets value based on `https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/wiki/P3A`\r\n\r\n---------\r\nVerification passed on Samsung Tab A with Android 10 running 1.20.100 x64 build\r\n- Verified P3A onboarding is shown on a clean install\r\n- Verified opt-in or opt-out on a clean install shows privacy stats onboarding immediately after P3A is dismissed\r\n- Verified onboarding is shown on an upgrade profile\r\n- Verified P3A metrics are captured based and sets value based on `https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/wiki/P3A`\r\n"
    },
    {
      "id": 778914663,
      "url": "https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/12723#issuecomment-778914663",
      "created_at": "2021-02-15T03:28:33Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "> How can I change this setting again? \n\n@newuser-web you can change it from settings-> Privacy. ![Screenshot_20210214-222739.png](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5146988/107902277-f75c1180-6f13-11eb-8dc7-3c8cbf467b80.png)"
    }
  ],

      "url": "https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/6688#issuecomment-550533691",

      "updated_at": "2019-12-03T22:57:53Z",
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "**Existing users flow**\r\nThis UI should be presented for all existing users. The UI can only be disabled via one of the two options.\r\n\r\nPressing the hardware back button shouldn’t close this UI. \r\n![p3a](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7606853/68344000-eda5f600-00a2-11ea-852f-50dac1c527a7.png)\r\n\r\n**New users flow**\r\nFor new users, also show the above UI after onboarding. \r\nThe UI can only be disabled via one of the two option\r\n\r\n\r\nRegarding the On|Off setting, in \r\nSettings>Privacy please add\r\n\r\n**Anonymously report feature usage**\r\nSend completely private product analytics to Brave. This info only lets Brave estimate the overall usage of certain features.\r\n\r\ncheckbox for On|Off\r\n\r\nPlace this setting above \"Do Not Track\" \r\n\r\ncc @bradleyrichter \r\n\r\nNote: Anonymously report feature usage may be too long, we'll have to see it on the device to confirm. "
    },
    {

      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 4",
      "body": "Closing this issue as we have covered it in https://github.com/brave/brave-browser/issues/12723"
    }
  ],

  "title": "Turn off/on state isn't retained for the P3A switch after the browser restart",
  "body": "<!-- Have you searched for similar issues on the repository?
Before submitting this issue, please visit our wiki for common ones: https://github.com/brave/browser-ios/wiki
For more, check out our community site: https://community.brave.com/ -->

### Description: 
Turn off/on state isn't retained for the P3A switch after the browser restart

### Steps to Reproduce 

Case 1:

  1. Clean profile 1.46 (22.12.1.21)
  2. Open settings
  3. Navigate to `Brave Shields & Privacy`
  4. Scroll down to Privacy settings
  5. Turn off the `Allow privacy-preserving product analysis (P3A)` switch
  6. Restart the browser (remove app from memory and relaunch)
  7. P3A switch is turned ON after the browser restart
 

Case 2:

  1. Clean profile 1.46 (22.12.1.21)
  2. Ensured P3A modal is shown in the onbrading after `Set Default` card/slide
  3. Turn off the `Show anonymus, private product insights` switch
  4. Navigate to `Brave Shields & Privacy`
  5. Scroll down to Privacy settings
  6. Ensured `Allow privacy-preserving product analysis (P3A)` switch is OFF
  7. Turn on the `Allow privacy-preserving product analysis (P3A)` switch
  8. Restart the browser (remove app from memory and relaunch)
  9. P3A switch is turned OFF after the browser restart
   
Case 3:

  1. Clean profile 1.45.x
  2. Upgrade profile to 1.46 (22.12.1.21)
  3. Ensured P3A modal is shown on the 1st launch in an upgraded profile
  4. Turn off the `Show anonymus, private product insights` switch
  5. Go to `Brave Shields & Privacy`
  6. Scroll down to Privacy settings
  7. Ensured `Allow privacy-preserving product analysis (P3A)` switch is OFF
  10. Turn ON the switch `Allow privacy-preserving product analysis (P3A)` 
  11. Restart the browser (remove app from memory and relaunch)
  12. P3A switch is turned OFF after the browser restart

**Actual result:** <!-- Add screenshots if needed -->
Turn off/on state isn't retained for the P3A switch after the browser restart

**Expected result:**
Turn off/on state should be retained for the P3A switch after the browser restart

**Reproduces how often:** [Easily reproduced, Intermittent Issue]
Easy

**Brave Version:** <!-- Provide full details Eg: v1.4.2(17.09.08.16) -->

1.46 (22.12.1.21)
**Device details:** <!-- Model type and iOS version Eg: iPhone 6s+ (iOS 10.3.3)-->

iPhone 8 - iOS 16.1.1
**Website problems only:**
- did you check with Brave Shields down?NA
- did you check in Safari/Firefox (WkWebView-based browsers)? NA


### Additional Information
